assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const m = $('1. Postgres: Fetch Pending Market Wrap').item.json; const parse = (v) => (typeof v === 'string' ? JSON.parse(v || '[]') : (v || [])); const mostActive = parse(m.most_active); const divStocks = parse(m.dividend_yield_stocks); const reitStocks = parse(m.reit_stocks); const t = (v) => ({ type: 'text', text: String(v ?? '') }); const d = { as_of: t(m.as_of_label || m.market_date), psei_value: t(m.psei_close), psei_up_down: t(m.psei_up_down), psei_arrow: t(m.psei_arrow), psei_change_pts: t(m.psei_change_pts), psei_change_pct: t((m.psei_change_pct ?? 0) + '%'), value_turnover: t('₱' + Number(m.total_value_turnover || 0).toLocaleString()), advancers: t(m.advancers), decliners: t(m.decliners), unchanged: t(m.unchanged), explanation: t($json.data['Canva Graphic Caption'] || ''), all_shares_arrow: t(m.all_shares_arrow), all_shares_value: t(m.all_shares_close), all_shares_chg_pct: t((m.all_shares_pct ?? 0) + '%'), all_shares_chg_pts: t(m.all_shares_change_pts), financial_arrow: t(m.financials_arrow), financial_value: t(m.financials_close), financial_chg_pct: t((m.financials_pct ?? 0) + '%'), financial_chg_pts: t(m.financials_change_pts), industrial_arrow: t(m.industrial_arrow), industrial_value: t(m.industrial_close), industrial_chg_pct: t((m.industrial_pct ?? 0) + '%'), industrial_chg_pts: t(m.industrial_change_pts), holding_firms_arrow: t(m.holding_firms_arrow), holding_firms_value: t(m.holding_firms_close), holding_firms_chg_pct: t((m.holding_firms_pct ?? 0) + '%'), holding_firms_chg_pts: t(m.holding_firms_change_pts), property_arrow: t(m.property_arrow), property_value: t(m.property_close), property_chg_pct: t((m.property_pct ?? 0) + '%'), property_chg_pts: t(m.property_change_pts), services_arrow: t(m.services_arrow), services_value: t(m.services_close), services_chg_pct: t((m.services_pct ?? 0) + '%'), services_chg_pts: t(m.services_change_pts), mining_oil_arrow: t(m.mining_oil_arrow), mining_oil_value: t(m.mining_oil_close), mining_oil_chg_pct: t((m.mining_oil_pct ?? 0) + '%'), mining_oil_chg_pts: t(m.mining_oil_change_pts) }; mostActive.slice(0, 3).forEach((s, idx) => { const n = idx + 1; d['most_active_' + n + '_rank'] = t(n); d['most_active_' + n + '_symbol'] = t(s.symbol); d['most_active_' + n + '_name'] = t(s.name); d['most_active_' + n + '_price'] = t(s.price_formatted); d['most_active_' + n + '_chg_pct'] = t(s.percent_change_formatted); d['most_active_' + n + '_value_traded'] = t(s.value_traded_formatted); d['most_active_' + n + '_trades'] = t(s.trades_formatted); }); divStocks.forEach((s) => { d['div_' + s.symbol + '_price'] = t(s.price_formatted); d['div_' + s.symbol + '_chg_pct'] = t(s.percent_change_formatted); d['div_' + s.symbol + '_dps'] = t('₱' + Number(s.div_per_share_ttm || 0).toFixed(2)); d['div_' + s.symbol + '_yield'] = t(Number(s.dividend_yield_ttm || 0).toFixed(2) + '%'); d['div_' + s.symbol + '_min_inv'] = t('₱' + Number(s.min_investment || 0).toLocaleString()); }); reitStocks.forEach((s) => { d['reit_' + s.symbol + '_price'] = t(s.price_formatted); d['reit_' + s.symbol + '_chg_pct'] = t(s.percent_change_formatted); d['reit_' + s.symbol + '_turnover'] = t(s.value_traded_formatted); d['reit_' + s.symbol + '_yield'] = t(Number(s.dividend_yield_ttm || 0).toFixed(2) + '%'); d['reit_' + s.symbol + '_min_inv'] = t('₱' + Number(s.min_investment || 0).toLocaleString()); }); return d; })() }}
